caption: The drawing depicts a single, central object resembling an antique powder flask, predominantly brown in color with a slightly reflective appearance and a carved leaf-like pattern on its rounded body. The flask has a brass or metallic spout at the top, with a lever on one side likely serving as a dispenser mechanism. Attached to both sides of the flask is a light green cord or strap, from which two large, fluffy green tassels hang down, one on each side. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or features present, thus focusing attention entirely upon the ornately decorated flask and its accoutrements.
title: Gunpowder Flask
